save.errorLong: Could not save. Your text is still here and saving is tried again, check that the file can be written to.
save.cannotClose: Your text could not be saved, so the project stays open. Check that the file and its folder can be written to. If you close it again now, the text that was not saved is lost.

math.empty: Type LaTeX to see a preview.
math.invalid: This formula has a syntax error.
math.hintInline: A formula inside the line. <c>Enter</c> confirms, <c>Esc</c> cancels.
math.hintBlock: A formula on its own line. <c>Enter</c> confirms, <c>Shift+Enter</c> adds a line, <c>Esc</c> cancels.

footnote.hint: Inline Markdown is allowed, for example <c>**bold**</c> or <c>$x^2$</c>.

citation.keysHint: Keys that are not in the bibliography yet. Separate several with commas, for example <c>wang2020, lee2019</c>.
citation.filter: Search by author, title or key
citation.noBibliography: The bibliography is empty. Add entries in Bibliography in the sidebar, or type keys below. Citations without an entry stay plain text in the PDF.

crossRef.unlabeled: Not labeled yet (a label is added automatically)
crossRef.none: There is nothing to refer to yet. Add a labeled heading, figure, table or equation first.
crossRef.placeholder: Choose a target to refer to

table.label: Table tools
table.replaceHint: The cells are replaced by the template. The label, caption, notes, place and size stay. Undo brings the old table back.
table.handle: Select the table, drag to move it
table.caption: Table caption and notes
table.rowHeightHint: A length such as <c>30pt</c>, <c>1cm</c> or <c>2em</c>. Leave empty for automatic height.
table.rowHeightInvalid: Use a number with a unit such as <c>pt</c>, <c>cm</c>, <c>mm</c>, <c>in</c> or <c>em</c>.
table.insertHint: A caption is optional. Without one the table has no number.

caption.captionHint: Inline Markdown is allowed. Leave empty for no caption.
caption.notesHint: Shown below the table, for example the source of the data.

figure.caption: Caption
figure.captionHint: Inline Markdown is allowed. Without a caption the image has no number.

crop.title: Crop the picture
crop.hint: Drag the frame or its corners. The original picture stays in the project.
crop.failed: The picture could not be cropped.

equation.title: Formula name
equation.name: Formula name
equation.taken: Another target already has this name.
equation.locked: This formula is referred to, so its name cannot be changed or removed.
equation.hint: A formula with a name is numbered and can be referred to.

text.name: Text
text.description: Plain text, the default block of the body.

heading1.name: Chapter title
heading1.description: The title of the chapter, it starts a new page in the thesis.

heading2.name: Section
heading2.description: The title of a section in a chapter.

heading4.name: Sub-subsection
heading4.description: A small heading below a subsection.

orderedList.name: Numbered list
orderedList.description: Steps or points that are counted.

quote.name: Quote
quote.description: A passage taken from another work.

rule.name: Divider
rule.description: A thin line that separates two parts of the text.

displayMath.name: Display formula
displayMath.description: A formula on its own line, which can be named to give it a number.

inlineMath.name: Inline formula
inlineMath.description: A short formula inside a line of text.

figure.name: Figure
figure.description: A picture with a caption, from a file on your computer.

table.name: Table
table.description: Rows and columns, with a caption and notes.

codeBlock.name: Code block
codeBlock.description: Program text in a box, with colors for the chosen language.

footnote.name: Footnote
footnote.description: A note at the foot of the page, marked in the text.

citation.name: Citation
citation.description: A reference to a work of the bibliography.

crossRef.name: Cross-reference
crossRef.description: A link to a figure, a table, a formula or a heading.

statement_definition.name: Definition
statement_definition.description: The exact meaning of a term or symbol.

statement_lemma.name: Lemma
statement_lemma.description: A small result that helps prove a theorem.

statement_theorem.name: Theorem
statement_theorem.description: A main result that is proved.

statement_proposition.name: Proposition
statement_proposition.description: A proved result of less weight than a theorem.

statement_corollary.name: Corollary
statement_corollary.description: A result that follows from a theorem.

statement_case.name: Case
statement_case.description: One case of a proof by cases.

statement_remark.name: Remark
statement_remark.description: A side note outside the main line.

statement_proof.name: Proof
statement_proof.description: Not numbered, ends with a box.

abstractZh.name: Chinese abstract
abstractZh.description: The abstract in Chinese, with its own page and the Chinese keywords.

abstractEn.name: English abstract
abstractEn.description: The abstract in English, with its own page and the English keywords.

landscape.name: Landscape page
landscape.description: For a wide table, its content is printed on a page turned sideways.

sample.heading: Section title
sample.footnote: This is the text of a footnote

card.citationMissing: This entry is not in the bibliography.

statement.titleHint: Shown after the number, such as Definition 1 (Norm).

placement.label: Placement
placement.followDefault: With none chosen, the setting of the thesis applies.

auto.name: Automatic
auto.hint: The layout picks the top or the bottom of a page.

near.name: Near the text
near.hint: As close to the text as it can. Typst has no such choice, so the PDF treats it as automatic.

top.name: Top of the page
top.hint: At the top of a page.

bottom.name: Bottom of the page
bottom.hint: At the bottom of a page.

page.name: Own page
page.hint: On a page of its own. Typst has no such choice, so the PDF puts it at the top of a page.

here.name: Exactly here
here.hint: Does not float, stays where it is in the text.

borders.label: Borders
borders.applyPen: Apply to the lines of the selection

tableTemplates.choose: Choose a template to see what it looks like.

flip.previous: Keep scrolling up to go back to {{title}}

landscape.head: Landscape page, what is here is printed on a page turned sideways
landscape.remove: Remove the landscape page and keep its content

abstract.headZh: Chinese abstract, printed under the title 摘要 with the Chinese keywords of the thesis settings
abstract.headEn: English abstract, printed under the title Abstract with the English keywords of the thesis settings
abstract.remove: Remove this part and keep what is written in it
